basic_info.description: 👋 I'm Erdem Hacıhasanoğlu, an Information Systems Engineering graduate of Kocaeli University and a software engineer with nearly 3 years of full stack experience. I focus on Node.js and NestJS on the backend and React and Next.js on the frontend. At Eteration, where I joined as a long-term intern and moved into a full-time role, I worked on large-scale projects for Türkiye Sigorta and Madame Coco: designing APIs, managing databases, integrating ERP, warehouse and e-commerce systems, and contributing to event-driven microservices with Kafka, Debezium, Keycloak, OpenTelemetry and Kubernetes. I'm looking for backend or full stack roles where I can help build scalable, maintainable software.

projects.title: Hes Otomotiv E-Commerce
projects.description: A custom e-commerce platform for an İstanbul-based auto parts company, live and still maintained. It has a Node.js (Express) backend with MongoDB for stock management, a React admin panel and a Next.js storefront, hosted on AWS EC2 with assets on S3. The admin panel and storefront code are on GitHub.

projects.title: Abalam E-Commerce
projects.description: A full stack e-commerce platform for a baby products store, live and still maintained. It has a Node.js backend with MongoDB, a React admin panel and a Next.js storefront, hosted on AWS EC2 with product photos stored on S3.

projects.title: Eteration Projects
projects.description: At Eteration I worked on large-scale projects for Türkiye Sigorta and Madame Coco: NestJS services for the Türkiye Sigorta mobile quick sale flow and the Saha360 field sales app (SOAP to REST integration), a full stack monitoring dashboard (NestJS, Next.js, Keycloak, WebSocket, Kafka, Debezium, InfluxDB), the integration layer between Madame Coco's ERP and Horoz Logistics' warehouse systems, and the middleware platform behind Madame Coco's European e-commerce site. I also worked on Reportback, a social media and web scraping analytics platform built with NestJS, Spring Boot and React Native.

projects.title: Emin Kardeşler Website
projects.description: A custom static corporate website built during my internship at Emin Kardeşler Makina, tailored to the company's requirements and deployed on the company's own server with Plesk.

projects.title: My School Projects
projects.description: Course projects from Kocaeli University in web development, deep learning, image processing and AI, built with JavaScript, C#, Java and Python. They are all available on my GitHub page.

projects.title: My Personal Website
projects.description: This website, where I introduce myself and share my projects and experience. It is built with React, Bootstrap and Sass, packaged with Docker and deployed automatically with GitHub Actions. The source code is on GitHub.
